subject: Re: Encord/Aqua Satellite - Follow up & Renewal
text:
Hi Alyssa,

I hope you’ve had a good week!

Following up on our previous conversation, Margaux and I would love to take you up on your suggestion for a working session! In addition to the panoptic bitmask/polygon import script, there are a couple of pain points we've encountered in our workflows:
Panoptic conversion script: Margaux previously worked on converting COCO files to panoptic COCO format using a script provided by Encord. She ran into issues and had to modify it to get it working. It would be great to review this together.
Image groups: We were wondering whether it's possible to delete individual images from image groups, or alternatively, convert them to separate images rather than keeping them as a grouped unit?
Would it be possible to address these items in working sessions? 

Thank you,
Iman

subject: Re: Encord & LVT: tracking data annotation
text:
Hi Alyssa,

Thank you for your reply. We have reviewed the answers, and to move
forward, our legal team has two requests that will help us better
understand the data flow and security posture.

1. Data flow diagrams
Could you please provide two separate data flow diagrams - one for the
standard integration architecture you are proposing and one for the
Docker-based solution? Each diagram should show the flow of LVT data and
clearly indicate where the data is transmitted, processed, and stored.
Please also include ingress and egress between your servers and our AWS
environment.

2. Security requirements spreadsheet
We also have a set of security requirements based on an industry framework
contributed by a number of large organizations (https://www.mvsp.dev/). Here
<https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1z1enk72tFhv_1CwiXrDSAtV6lDmxR56aSLEyNzm1p2k/edit?gid=1212313689#gid=1212313689>
is the spreadsheet of controls and we would appreciate your help completing
it with the new proposed solutions. Please also add any relevant
commentary. Editor access has been granted to you.

Thank you in advance, and please let us know if you have any questions.

Regards,

Zhengwei

subject: Re: GLO - new project possibilities
text:
Hi Shivant and Arish!
Thank you for the meeting on Friday; it gave our team a lot to consider. In
preparation for our follow-up tomorrow, we’ve compiled a list of specific
questions we’d like to dive into:

   1. Could you provide specific performance benchmarks and data regarding
   the average annotation throughput we can expect when using your system?
   2. Including various scenarios: manual only; semi-automation (mark 250
   frames), agent usage etc.
   3. Is it possible to increase the current 250-frame limit per annotation
   task to accommodate longer sequences?
   4. Does the platform support the concurrent processing of multiple video
   files?
   5. Could you demonstrate how a foundation VLM handles tasks of
   segmentation and action recognition in a medical setting?
   6. Could you provide more information regarding the new 'Data Agents'
   and their claimed ability to annotate hundreds of hours of video?
   7. Can you demonstrate specific platform features designed to accelerate
   the annotation and review process, such as multi-view review windows or
   automated multi-object tracking?
   8. Since we don't have demo access, could you host a workshop for us to
   demonstrate the platform's capabilities using a sample of our own video
   data? We are specifically interested in seeing how segmentation and action
   recognition are handled and how foundation VLMs and Data Agents can
   accelerate our workflow.

Please let us know if you need any clarification on these points before we
meet.
Looking forward to the discussion!

Best regards,
Mykhailo
